evals.name: trading-phases-from-design
evals.expected_output: From the design alone: the split shown in chat and approved, then an overview that points to the design, one note per phase with a complete Evals table, a ledger, and one eval set per behavioral target written by parallel writer subagents
expectations: The transcript shows the design file read, and no read of any conversation, earlier plan's notes, or file outside the fixture and plugin-dev
The split was shown in chat as a table with the columns Phase, What it adds, Depends on, Evals, May pair with, and approved before any note was written
outputs/trading-agents/site/notes/0.1-00-overview.md exists, names 0.1-design.md, and has no Why, Decisions taken, The flow or Non-goals section

Phase 1 is the design's smallest end-to-end slice: the phase-1 note builds the filing reader, its checker or the status layer, and a deep-dive stopping at the status file, and no comparison, news or thesis
The filing-checker ships in the same phase as filing-reader or the phase right after it, never later
thesis-critic is in its own phase or an optional addition to one, and no other phase depends on it
The phase-1 note has the sections, in order: a purpose paragraph, Decisions, Files, Specification, Steps, Evals, Done when
Every phase note's '## Evals' table has exactly the columns ID, Kind, Target, Baseline, Set evals, Pass bar, and every Kind is one of: mechanical, load, behavioral, trigger, platform-fact
The design's two assumed platform facts appear as platform-fact rows in phase 0 or the ledger's phase-0 row
The transcript shows one subagent per behavioral target spawned in a single message, each given the eval-writer prompt

Every behavioral row names a set file under evals/sets/ and eval IDs that exist in that set in outputs/, and each set has id, name, kind, baseline, prompt, expected_output and a non-empty expectations list per eval
Every harness file a set names under evals/sets/files/ was also written
outputs/trading-agents/site/notes/0.1-progress.md has phase 0 'in progress' and every other row 'todo'
outputs/chat.md gives the line to run /plugin-dev:run-phase 0.1 and the number of phases
evals.added_in: design-plugin split (replaces the old eval 4, trading-through-phase-notes)

evals.name: gap-asked-not-guessed
evals.expected_output: The design no longer states how far back filings go; the skill asks rather than picking a horizon, writes the answer into the design with Origin planning, and the notes use the answer
expectations: outputs/interview.md contains a question about how far back the filings go (the horizon, number of quarters or filings) asked before any phase note was written
The design copy's Decisions taken table has a new row for the filing horizon with Origin 'planning' and the answer 'last 8 quarterly filings and the latest 10-K'
Every phase note that states a filing horizon states the one from the answer, and no phase note states any other horizon
The skill did not redraw or edit any mermaid chart in the design copy
The split was shown in chat and approved before any note was written
